_comment: Camera (flight_core::camera::CameraTuning). Assumed values. chase_offset: seated camera in ship space (x right, y up, z back, m); chase_pitch_deg: its pitch against the nose (negative looks down). fov_curve: speed m/s -> vertical FOV deg. streak_curve: speed m/s -> speed dust level (0 none, 0.2 and more full thickness). Look-ahead: the view leads a turn by gain x turn rate, past the dead zone (rad/s), capped, eased. Bump: touchdown drop per m/s of approach speed, damped; the bump comes when the hull starts touching, if the approach speed just before was above bump_threshold m/s.
